name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 14 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2025-07-08, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
